Announces General Availability of Vaikora, an AI Runtime Enforcement Platform for Agentic AI Inline
allow, block and constrain controls for AI actions, data flows and agent-to-agent communication — with an audit record for every
enforced decision RESEARCH
TRIANGLE PARK, N.C., October 14, 2026 — Data443 Risk Mitigation, Inc. (OTCPK: ATDS) (“Data443” or the “Company”),
a data security and privacy software company for “All Things Data Security,” today announced the general availability of
Vaikora, its AI runtime enforcement and control platform. Vaikora
is designed to sit inline between artificial intelligence systems and the actions those systems take. Rather than inspecting AI behavior
after the fact, Vaikora evaluates each action against policy at runtime and allows it, blocks it, or constrains it — and records
what happened. What
Vaikora enforces ● Agent
                                            actions — tool and function calls an AI agent attempts to execute on a customer’s
                                            systems. ● Data
                                            flows — what an AI system is permitted to read, retain, transmit, or expose, and to
                                            whom. ● Governance
                                            policy — organization-defined rules applied consistently across models rather than
                                            re-implemented per application. ● Agent-to-agent
                                            communication — the messages autonomous components exchange with one another. Vaikora
is designed to operate with commercial models and with specific open-source models, so that a single policy layer can govern a heterogeneous
AI estate rather than binding an organization to one vendor’s controls. How
this applies to today’s market Enterprises
are moving AI agents out of pilots and into production, where those agents act on real systems and real data. The access controls most
organizations already own were designed for human users and for applications — not for autonomous software acting on a person’s
behalf, at machine speed, across multiple models. Vaikora is Data443’s answer to that gap. The
platform is built on the same data classification, discovery and policy foundation the Company has shipped to enterprise and government
customers for nearly a decade. Data443 serves more than 10,000 customers in over 100 countries, and has expanded that foundation through
asset acquisitions including Cyren, ArcMail, FileFacets and TacitRed. Vaikora applies that lineage — knowing what data is, where
it lives, and what may be done with it — to AI systems. Availability Vaikora
is generally available today. The Company is also operating a strategic partner program for platform, cloud and security providers seeking
to embed or resell runtime enforcement. Information on the platform and on partner participation is available at https://data443.com. “Every
enterprise I talk to has agents in production and no way to stop one when it does something it shouldn’t,” said Jason Remillard,
Chief Executive Officer and Founder of Data443. “We have spent a decade answering the question of what a piece of data is and who
is allowed to touch it. Vaikora takes that same discipline and puts it in front of the AI — in line, in real time, with a record
of every decision. That is the control enterprises are asking for before they scale agents any further.” About
Data443 Risk Mitigation, Inc. Data443
Risk Mitigation, Inc. (OTCPK: ATDS) provides software and services to enable secure data across devices and databases, both at rest and
in transit, locally, on a network, or in the cloud. We are All Things Data Security™. With over 10,000 customers in more than 100
countries, Data443 offers a modern approach to data governance and security by identifying and protecting all sensitive data, regardless
of location, platform, or format. Data443’s framework helps customers prioritize risk, identify security gaps, and implement effective
data protection and privacy management strategies. Data443 is headquartered in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina. For more information,
visit https://data443.com. Contacts Investor
